metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2026 · Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · Baththa
metas.description: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally locks a feared criminal inside a school restroom. As the man faces hunger and isolation, an unexpected friendship forms between them, transforming both their lives.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar
metas.description: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Fjord
metas.description: An immigrant Romanian family living in Norway is subject to an investigation and faces the scrutiny of the local judicial system.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · M4M: Motive for Murder
metas.description: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 2025 · Gondhal
metas.description: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.
